<mujoco model="motionfit_demo-v0">
  <compiler angle="radian"/>
  <option timestep="0.002" integrator="implicitfast" gravity="0 0 -9.81"/>
  <worldbody>
    <body name="base" pos="0 0 0">
      <inertial pos="0 0 0.06" mass="0.302" diaginertia="1e-3 1e-3 1e-3"/>
      <joint name="J1" type="hinge" axis="0 0 1" range="-2.97 2.97" damping="0.05" frictionloss="0.005"/>
      <geom name="g_base" type="cylinder" fromto="0 0 0 0 0 0.12" size="0.017499999999999998" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
      <body name="shoulder" pos="0 0 0.12">
        <inertial pos="0.08820826337606504 0 0" mass="0.19905574227275574" diaginertia="2.5597677657844707e-05 0.0019806785454001903 0.0019806785454001903"/>
        <joint name="J2" type="hinge" axis="0 -1 0" range="-0.52 2.62" damping="0.05" frictionloss="0.005"/>
        <geom name="g_link1" type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0.3 0 0" size="0.0125" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
        <body name="elbow" pos="0.3 0 0">
          <inertial pos="0.06791170952209369 0 0" mass="0.17954645189396312" diaginertia="2.2998064714870587e-05 0.0012206484919066202 0.0012206484919066202"/>
          <joint name="J3" type="hinge" axis="0 -1 0" range="-2.62 2.62" damping="0.05" frictionloss="0.005"/>
          <geom name="g_link2" type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0.25 0 0" size="0.0125" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
          <body name="wrist" pos="0.25 0 0">
            <inertial pos="0.018656716417910446 0 0" mass="0.1072" diaginertia="1.5625e-05 8.216573383084578e-05 8.216573383084578e-05"/>
            <joint name="J4" type="hinge" axis="0 -1 0" range="-2.09 2.09" damping="0.05" frictionloss="0.005"/>
            <geom name="g_link3" type="capsule" fromto="0 0 0 0.08 0 0" size="0.012" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/>
            <body name="tool" pos="0.08 0 0">
              <inertial pos="0 0 0" mass="0.4" diaginertia="1e-5 1e-5 1e-5"/>
              <site name="ee" pos="0 0 0" size="0.01"/>
            </body>
          </body>
        </body>
      </body>
    </body>
  </worldbody>
  <actuator>
    
    <motor name="m_J1" joint="J1" gear="1" ctrllimited="true" ctrlrange="-4.1 4.1"/>
    
    <motor name="m_J2" joint="J2" gear="1" ctrllimited="true" ctrlrange="-4.1 4.1"/>
    
    <motor name="m_J3" joint="J3" gear="1" ctrllimited="true" ctrlrange="-4.1 4.1"/>
    
    <motor name="m_J4" joint="J4" gear="1" ctrllimited="true" ctrlrange="-1.4 1.4"/>
    
  </actuator>
</mujoco>

proposal.diagnosis: Joint J2 (XM430-W350) fails during phase 'fast_extended_lift' at t=3.27 s: required peak torque is 4.25 N·m vs 3.65 N·m available (peak_ratio=1.13 > 0.80), and RMS torque is 2.34 N·m vs 1.35 N·m continuous limit (rms_ratio=1.73 > 1.00), saturating the actuator for 4.28 s and causing 295.1 mm end-effector tracking droop.

changes.rationale: Upgrade J2 from XM430-W350 to XM540-W270 (stall torque 10.6 N·m, continuous torque 3.5 N·m, no-load speed 3.142 rad/s, mass 0.165 kg). Because J2 sits at the shoulder base, its +0.083 kg mass increase does not add gravity moment arm to distal links, while lowering J2 peak torque ratio to 0.55 and RMS torque ratio to 0.67.

citations.quote: Stall Torque: 10.6 N·m; Continuous Torque: 3.5 N·m; No-Load Speed: 3.142 rad/s

thought_summary: Evaluated coupled 4-DOF inverse dynamics across J1–J4: J2 gravitational + inertial moment peaks during extended horizontal reach (q2 -> 0.36 rad). Evaluated catalog actuators on the 12V/24V bus against linear torque-speed derating and thermal RMS limits.

proposal.diagnosis: All 17 verification checks pass with XM540-W270 on J2 (peak_ratio=0.47, rms_ratio=0.67). However, XM540-W270 adds 0.165 kg and $485. Pairing the lighter XM430-W350 (0.082 kg, $310) with the APEX-PG20-2 2:1 planetary stage (0.065 kg, $115, 92% efficiency) delivers 7.544 N·m effective stall torque and 2.484 N·m continuous torque, saving 18 g and $60 while keeping J2 within thermal and peak margins.

changes.rationale: Revert J2 motor to XM430-W350 (stall torque 4.1 N·m, continuous torque 1.35 N·m, mass 0.082 kg) to reduce shoulder housing mass and cost when paired with a 2:1 inline reducer.

citations.quote: Stall Torque (12.0 V): 4.1 N·m; Continuous Torque: 1.35 N·m; Mass: 82 g

changes.rationale: Add APEX-PG20-2 inline planetary gearbox (ratio 2.0:1, efficiency 0.92, rated output torque 18.0 N·m, mass 0.065 kg) on J2, multiplying motor torque by 2.0 * 0.92 = 1.84x.

citations.quote: Reduction Ratio: 2.0:1; Efficiency: 92%; Rated Output Torque: 18.0 N·m; Mass: 65 g
